nodes.title: Foundation Phase
nodes.description: Foundation Phase (Grades R-3)

nodes.title: Grade 1
nodes.description: Grade 1

nodes.title: Mathematics
nodes.description: Mathematics for Grade 1 — Foundation Phase CAPS

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: Grade 1 Mathematics Term 1 (45 days)

nodes.title: Numbers, Operations and Relationships
nodes.description: Count to 99; number concept to 20; order and compare numbers; place value (tens and units); addition and subtraction to 20; number sentences

nodes.title: Patterns, Functions and Algebra
nodes.description: Copy, extend and describe simple patterns; create own patterns using objects, drawings, sounds, movements

nodes.title: Space and Shape (Geometry)
nodes.description: Position and directions; recognise, identify and name 2D shapes and 3D objects; describe, sort and compare 2D shapes and 3D objects

nodes.title: Measurement
nodes.description: Time: sequence events; read and write dates; names of days of week; Time: order regular events from own life. Length: compare and order objects using non-standard measures

nodes.title: Data Handling
nodes.description: Collect, sort and represent data; discuss and report on sorted data

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: Grade 1 Mathematics Term 2 (49 days)

nodes.title: Numbers, Operations and Relationships
nodes.description: Count to 99; number concept to 50; place value (tens and units to 50); addition and subtraction to 50; grouping and sharing equally; fractions (halves and quarters of whole objects)

nodes.title: Patterns, Functions and Algebra
nodes.description: Copy, extend and describe geometric patterns; create own patterns

nodes.title: Space and Shape (Geometry)
nodes.description: Symmetry: recognise and draw line of symmetry in 2D shapes

nodes.title: Measurement
nodes.description: Time: telling time in hours and half hours on analogue clocks; Mass: compare and order objects by mass; Capacity/Volume: compare and order objects by capacity

nodes.title: Data Handling
nodes.description: Collect, sort, represent and interpret data using tally marks and pictographs

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: Grade 1 Mathematics Term 3 (49 days)

nodes.title: Numbers, Operations and Relationships
nodes.description: Count to 99; number concept to 75; place value (tens and units to 75); addition and subtraction to 75; repeated addition; multiplication and division with grouping and sharing

nodes.title: Patterns, Functions and Algebra
nodes.description: Number patterns: copy, extend, describe and create number patterns; input and output number patterns

nodes.title: Space and Shape (Geometry)
nodes.description: Position and views: position of objects in space; recognise and describe 2D shapes and 3D objects in the environment

nodes.title: Measurement
nodes.description: Time: telling time in quarter hours; Length: estimate, measure, compare and order objects using non-standard units

nodes.title: Data Handling
nodes.description: Collect, sort, represent and interpret data; answer questions about data in pictographs and bar graphs

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: Grade 1 Mathematics Term 4 (49 days)

nodes.title: Numbers, Operations and Relationships
nodes.description: Count to 999; number concept to 99; place value (tens and units to 99); addition and subtraction to 99; fractions (halves, quarters, thirds); money: recognise and use coins and bank notes

nodes.title: Patterns, Functions and Algebra
nodes.description: Number patterns: extend and describe number sequences; geometric patterns: extend and describe patterns

nodes.title: Space and Shape (Geometry)
nodes.description: 3D objects and 2D shapes: sort, describe and compare; identify faces, edges and vertices of 3D objects

nodes.title: Measurement
nodes.description: Time: read calendars; Mass and Capacity revision; Perimeter: informal measurement of perimeter

nodes.title: Data Handling
nodes.description: Collect, organise, represent and interpret data; use bar graphs, pictographs and tallies; answer questions about data
